_comment: Owner-curated EVENT CALENDAR for the tracked universe (tradeable-rec-inputs item 4). NOT a secret — checked in for git-reviewed provenance, same shape and operational story as universe.json (edit + restart; no hot-reload). EXISTS BECAUSE: Massive/Polygon's earnings feed (list_benzinga_earnings) is a separate add-on our plan is NOT entitled to (probed 2026-07-27), and scheduled macro events are not a Massive product at all. Owner-curated config decouples the calendar from the vendor entirely.
_honesty_contract: ABSENT IS NOT NONE. A symbol with NO entry under 'symbols' means WE DO NOT KNOW its schedule — it must NEVER be rendered or reasoned about as 'no earnings scheduled'. A symbol present with an EMPTY events list means the opposite: someone checked and there is nothing scheduled WITHIN 'covers'. These are different claims and the loader keeps them distinct (None vs []). Any consumer that collapses them is wrong.
_covers_contract: 'covers' scopes what an empty list asserts. This pass covered EARNINGS ONLY. So an ETF's [] means 'no earnings' — it does NOT mean 'no ex-dividend', which these ETFs certainly have. Do not widen 'covers' without actually curating the added type.
_staleness_contract: An earnings calendar rots fast. Entries marked confirmed:false are projections from last year's cadence and MUST be re-fetched ~2-3 weeks before their listed date, which is when companies actually publish their advisories. Note several mega-caps report within days of as_of — this file's near-term half is historical almost immediately. A stale calendar is worse than an empty one.
_provenance: Compiled 2026-07-27 by five parallel research passes under a never-guess standard: a date was recorded only when a source could be cited, 'confirmed' set true only on a company IR/press-release announcement (not an aggregator's 'confirmed' badge), and irreconcilable source conflicts returned as UNRESOLVED rather than picked. Aggregator errors caught and corrected: BA is 07-28 (not the 07-29 on Investing.com/MarketBeat), MSTR is 07-30 (not Aug 4), WFC Q3 was MOVED by a Feb-2026 update (the cached 2025 schedule is stale), and OXY's release is 08-05 while oxy.com lists only the 08-06 CALL.

_unresolved._note: IGNORED BY THE LOADER (every _-prefixed key is). These 4 are deliberately ABSENT from 'symbols' so they read as UNKNOWN. Recorded here only so the next curator does not repeat the search. Do NOT promote any of these into 'symbols' without a real source.

_unresolved.MU: Three sources, three dates spanning 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-29 (MarketBeat 09-22 estimated, WSH 09-23 unconfirmed, Investing/TipRanks 09-29). Micron has not issued its fiscal-Q4 advisory.
